problem: Consider the finite region $D$ in the $xy$-plane enclosed by the curve $y={e}^{x},$ and the lines $y=1-x$ and $x=1.$ Express ${∬}_{D}f(x,y)\,dA$ as a sum of repeated integrals over type II regions.
worked_solution:
First, let's write our equations in terms of $y,$ as follows:

$$
\begin{aligned}y={e}^{x} & \,⟹\,x=\operatorname{ln}⁡y \\ y=1-x & \,⟹\,x=1-y\end{aligned}
$$

Now, let's sketch our region.

![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/question-capture-workers/multivariable/14070962/assets/0c61de3680b68dcf16267483fe1a51f0ef0e4c8247104215ae319d6c01b7a571.png)

  

The region $D$ can be partitioned into two type II regions ${D}_{1}$ and ${D}_{2},$ as shown below. 

![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/question-capture-workers/multivariable/14070962/assets/c2a3cd01f74a2adb96e13212916dbb1b4476040d701ccd755258bd22fdefa5de.png)

  

As a result, we get

$$
{D}_{1}={(x,y)\,:\,0\le y\le 1,\,1-y\le x\le 1}
$$

and 

$$
{D}_{2}={(x,y)\,:\,1\le y\le e,\,\operatorname{ln}⁡y\le x\le 1}.
$$

Therefore, using the additivity property of double integrals, we obtain 

$$
\begin{aligned}{∬}_{D}f(x,y)\,dA & ={∬}_{{D}_{1}}f(x,y)\,dA+{∬}_{{D}_{2}}f(x,y)\,dA \\  & ={\int }_{0}^{1}{\int }_{1-y}^{1}f(x,y)\,\text{d}x\,\text{d}y+{\int }_{1}^{e}{\int }_{\operatorname{ln}⁡y}^{1}f(x,y)\,\text{d}x\,\text{d}y.\end{aligned}
$$
